_README: HPC / Apptainer settings for the openWQ calibration setup report.
Fill these in ONCE. When this file is present (and your calibration template
points 'hpc_settings_json' at it), the interactive report opens with its
'if running on HPC / Apptainer' fields (Execution tab) already filled in.
You can still edit any field in the browser. Any key starting with '_'
(like this one) is ignored, so use them freely for your own notes.
TIP: copy this file (e.g. hpc_settings_<cluster>.json), fill it in, and set
hpc_settings_json = "/path/to/your_copy.json" near the top of your
calibration template so the same details are reused across runs.
FIELD-BY-FIELD
hpc_username              Your login name on the cluster - the part before '@'
in 'ssh username@host'.
hpc_login_hostname        The login node you ssh into,
e.g. login.deucalion.macc.fccn.pt
hpc_working_dir           A WRITABLE directory on the cluster where the model,
inputs, the SLURM job file and all calibration outputs
are staged. It is created automatically (mkdir -p) and
every absolute path is re-pointed under it. Big HDF5
output lands here, so prefer scratch/projects storage
with enough space/quota - not your (small) $HOME.
apptainer_sif_path_on_hpc Absolute path to the openWQ .sif ON the cluster.
IMPORTANT: BUILD THE .sif ON THE HPC ITSELF - Apptainer
images are CPU-architecture specific and must be built
where they run; it is NOT uploaded. Build once with:
apptainer build openwq.sif \
<openwq>/containers/openwq_apptainer.def
then put that absolute path here (often inside
hpc_working_dir, e.g. <hpc_working_dir>/openwq.sif).
openwq_repo_path_on_hpc   Absolute path to the openWQ checkout INSIDE your
host-model clone on the cluster - the folder that
contains supporting_scripts/ (the inner '.../openwq/openwq').
Point at that folder OR its parent; the sbatch
auto-locates supporting_scripts/3_Calibration/calibration_lib
under it.  The CODE is used from there - NOT copied - so
you don't re-ship libraries you already cloned (exported
as OWQ_CALIB_LIB_DIR). e.g. /home/$USER/.../openwq/openwq
executable_path_on_hpc   Absolute path to the host-model binary you COMPILED on
the cluster (summa / mizuroute / mizuroute_cslm - whichever
you built). The .sif holds only dependencies, so the model
is run from this binary. This is the ONLY per-coupling path
the tool can't infer; inputs, .sif and calibration_lib are
automatic. Exported as OWQ_EXEC_PATH.
e.g. $HPC_BASE/.../bin/summa_openwq_Release
SLURM directives (these populate the #SBATCH lines of the generated job file)
slurm_job_name            #SBATCH --job-name. Also names the .out log file.
slurm_account             #SBATCH --account: your compute allocation/project.
Required on most clusters (fairshare/billing).
slurm_partition           #SBATCH --partition (queue). Use a PRODUCTION queue for
real calibrations; dev/debug queues usually cap walltime
very low (~1 h). Leave "" to use the cluster default.
slurm_walltime            #SBATCH --time, wall-clock limit as HH:MM:SS
(e.g. 48:00:00). Must fit within the partition's max.
slurm_cpus_per_task       #SBATCH --cpus-per-task. Set this >= the calibration's
n_parallel so every parallel model run gets a core.
slurm_mem_per_node        #SBATCH --mem, memory per node (e.g. "16G").
slurm_modules_to_load     Shell line(s) run on the compute node before the job,
to put python + apptainer on PATH, e.g.
"module load apptainer python". Leave "" if they are
already available by default.
